evidence.quote:
# TypeSafe Agent Skills

Agent skills for building with [TypeSafe](https://typesafe.ai): typed decisions and probabilities from System One models.

You can [read SKILL.md on GitHub](https://github.com/typesafe-ai/skills/blob/main/skills/typesafe-ai/SKILL.md) or fetch its [raw Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/typesafe-ai/skills/main/skills/typesafe-ai/SKILL.md).

| Skill | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [typesafe-ai](skills/typesafe-ai/SKILL.md) | Design TypeSafe workflows, find current docs and cookbooks, and compose typed judgments in code |

claims.text: The skill describes Jev as a System One model returning typed answers and probabilities for application-controlled workflows.

evidence.quote:
TypeSafe makes units of AI intelligence usable like programming primitives: small
judgments you can compose into larger capabilities. Its **System One models** return
fast, focused judgments that software can consume directly. **Jev** is TypeSafe's
flagship and first System One model. It understands natural language and returns
typed answers and probabilities rather
than generating text or reasoning explanations. Code owns the workflow; the model
supplies programmable common sense where ordinary code needs semantic understanding.

claims.text: Install the Claude Code plugin or the skills.sh package, then request a workflow such as support-ticket routing with uncertain cases reviewed.

evidence.quote:
### Claude Code plugin

Run in your terminal:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add typesafe-ai/skills
claude plugin install typesafe@typesafe-ai
```

### Other agents via skills.sh

```bash
npx skills add typesafe-ai/skills --skill typesafe-ai
```

Select your agent when prompted. Installation is project-local by default; add `-g` to install globally.

Ask your agent, for example:

> Use TypeSafe to route incoming support tickets by department, with human review for uncertain decisions.

In Claude Code, you can explicitly invoke the plugin skill with `/typesafe:typesafe-ai`.

claims.text: Installation through skills.sh is project-local by default. The skill supplies guidance; live TypeSafe documentation carries current API contracts, model limits and examples.

evidence.quote:
### Other agents via skills.sh

```bash

```

Select your agent when prompted. Installation is project-local by default; add `-g` to install globally.

See the [installation guide](https://docs.typesafe.ai/agent-skill#installation) for a prompt to copy to your agent, manual installation, and updates.

**The live TypeSafe docs are the source of truth. Read them as part of the task.**
This skill gives direction; the docs carry current concepts, prompting guidance,
API contracts, SDK usage, models, limits, and worked examples.

it.h1: TypeSafe Agent Skills: guida allo sviluppo con Jev
it.description: TypeSafe Agent Skills guida gli agenti di codice nella progettazione di decisioni tipizzate con Jev e modelli System One.
it.summary: La risorsa ufficiale aiuta a progettare flussi TypeSafe, trovare documentazione e comporre giudizi tipizzati nel codice. La skill descrive Jev come modello System One che restituisce risposte tipizzate e probabilità; il flusso è controllato dall'applicazione.

sections.heading: Scopo e destinatari
sections.text: La risorsa ufficiale aiuta a progettare flussi TypeSafe, trovare documentazione e comporre giudizi tipizzati nel codice.

sections.heading: Ruolo di Jev
sections.text: La skill descrive Jev come modello System One che restituisce risposte tipizzate e probabilità; il flusso è controllato dall'applicazione.

sections.heading: Come si usa
sections.text: Si installa il plugin Claude Code o il pacchetto skills.sh e si richiede, per esempio, instradamento dei ticket con revisione dei casi incerti.

sections.heading: Ambito e limiti
sections.text: L’installazione tramite skills.sh è locale al progetto per impostazione predefinita. La skill orienta; la documentazione TypeSafe online contiene contratti API, limiti ed esempi aggiornati.
